verdict.rationale: Jitsu has no named sandbox or test workspace. It does offer ways to test without touching production: the Functions debugger runs functions on sample data, `jitsu-cli init` scaffolds a TypeScript Functions project with tests, and a zero-config development Helm chart deploys the full stack to Minikube as an isolated environment. Missing for 10: a first-class sandbox or test workspace with isolated test credentials, documented separation of test and production destinations, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandboxed testing workflows.
